at.description: Absolute instant, resolved server-side (09 §9.2). On input: an instant with its offset, or a time of the show (HH:MM).

time.description: Set when the cue was given as a time of the show: it belongs to the show's night and follows its date (09 §9.3).

clockGap.description: Its time is one a clock change skips; `at` is where it moved to (09 §9.2).

clockOverlap.description: Its time happens twice on a clock change; `at` is the first (09 §9.2).

edited.description: A generated cue the operator changed: rebuilds leave it as it is.

stepsDone.description: A sequence that fired: how many of its steps are done (applied, missed or skipped). The rest are still to come, after a restart too.

error.description: Why a fired cue did nothing (no member has the action, the clip isn't ready …).

slot.description: A lineup position, or an act's name (which follows the act through lineup edits).

connection.description: connector.action: the connection whose action runs.

connector.description: connector.action: the connector, when one connection of it is on (else name the connection).
